recommended_strategy: Harvest all 15 pages of the Store API (~1MB JSON per page; 1 req/sec). Build a list of family names; for each Lumera SKU pick the LONGEST family name that is a prefix of the SKU (after uppercasing). Then pick the image whose filename (minus extension and trailing '-n' index) best matches family + finish code found in the SKU (e.g. trailing BZ/B/W/BB/SB/MPW/HZW before '/' options); otherwise use the first image. Images are full-size wp-content/uploads JPGs (exact upload-path dates vary; take src from API).
